newsitem.title: USA: Body of British major found in New Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Body of British major found in New Mexico.

text.p: The badly decomposed body of a British army major missing for four months was found hidden under tree branches and rocks in a remote area of eastern New Mexico, the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) said Wednesday.
Maj. David Nichols appeared to have been shot twice in the head, said FBI agent Ron Dick.
Dick said two convicts who escaped from an Alabama prison May 21 and went on a cross-country journey before being recaptured in July were the only suspects in the case.

Nichols, who was in the United States for training, was last seen alive May 26 buying gasoline in the town of Raton in northeastern New Mexico. His rental car was found dumped in a lake in Indiana, Dick said.
Dick said FBI agents were led to the body by information from an undisclosed source. The body was found near the town of Villanueva, New Mexico, about 80 miles (128 km) southeast of Albuquerque.
The two escaped convicts were back in jail and awaiting charges in the Nichols case, said Ron Lopez, spokesman for the U.S. Attorney's Office in New Mexico.
Dick said Nichols' body would be returned to Britain after medical investigators complete their work.
